evidence_items.explanation: Supports the revenue component as a reported annualized rate. It does not establish realized annual revenue or financial sustainability.

evidence_items.explanation: Challenges $1.6 billion as the latest revenue rate: a higher December estimate was public before the post. Higher revenue alone does not establish that the company could cover its costs.

receipt.public_excerpt: Mr Altman has said OpenAI remains lossmaking because of the vast costs of building and running its models.

evidence_items.explanation: Contemporary reporting supports the direction of the sustainability concern. It does not quantify the funding gap for the selected quarter or identify the accounting measure of loss, so it is contextual.

unresolved_gaps: No accessible financial statement or sufficiently detailed report establishes the size of the operating or cash shortfall for October–December 2023.
The accessible loss report does not specify the loss measure or quantify how far the company was from covering its costs.
The $1.6 billion and above-$2 billion reports do not identify sufficiently precise measurement dates to reconcile their differing run rates.
